book.title: 1Tesalonika Tesalonika Ekalesia veize Pauloꞌa Mirihiroteꞌe Soꞌaḡa Ibiꞌa

content: Badiꞌa Matuꞌohauꞌeteꞌe Ḡaboneḡa

Ḡonagano, nego nabudi, emeꞌa ibite Badiꞌa matuꞌohafine nougenouge raditeꞌe moneo ihoziro, ebu zaꞌe ꞌouge radiuꞌohe. Izidi eme zaeꞌa ufeta ꞌouge haḡae radoga veize Zuhiꞌa Boro niḡano umizeꞌohe zu inaraziꞌohe.
Mazaḡa zaꞌe edeḡa, emeꞌa Zuhiꞌa Boro Iesu niḡano nagi ihoreḡa ziniro.
Badiꞌaꞌe zaeꞌa zaḡozaḡe radoga urateꞌohe. Zaꞌe mene daro futaꞌuma,
zae tibatibaꞌa zaḡozaḡe zu gubaneꞌeteꞌe ibiḡano nougenouge ahirize
taufeꞌeteꞌe ederiꞌuma,
Badiꞌa aḡuꞌa azaḡa, mene Iuda azaḡa teige, ubuma gezo mene haḡaiꞌuma,

ebu ꞌuguḡa haḡaiḡa nego nabudi mazao haḡadu mene mae veꞌoziꞌuma zu sausauziꞌuma. Emeꞌa amahi zae ziroteꞌe zu riḡa iraduguziroteꞌe teige, Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌa haḡai ꞌuguḡa niduꞌa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa aduga ziniꞌuma.
Eme toragano mene radifine, rehano zaḡozaḡe ḡabode radifine Badiꞌaꞌa emeḡe hufiro.
Eꞌanoꞌo ihore ꞌadi hezahohauꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe mene vaze hezahohauꞌohe, rehano Vine Zaḡoḡa ziniꞌeteꞌe Badiꞌaḡa hezahohauꞌohe.
U nego nabudi zamarotitoga moneoꞌe emeꞌa mirihozenoga mene urateꞌohe, mazaḡa za zaeꞌa bare Badiꞌa mazaonoꞌo zamarotiteꞌeteꞌe ihoreḡa meiro.
Ebu hube hune zaꞌe Makedonia habaꞌano nego nabudi niduꞌa zamare borofeꞌohe. Rehano, nego nabudi, emeꞌa bare umizeꞌohe, “Za ufeta zamarotitoꞌi.”
Ebu emeꞌa zae ziroteꞌe idunaḡano roḡeru radifine inaroꞌi, zae gau faine zamareꞌenaꞌa ḡihau gauoꞌi, ebu ꞌevoreze hina gaue radoꞌi.
ꞌOugine, mene fieꞌeteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa zae gubaziꞌuma, zu ferezeꞌeteꞌe ḡauḡa ꞌahoga oꞌoꞌa radu vaze mazao ḡau ꞌahoga mene umidiꞌuma.
Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌa Bare Ariꞌuma
Nego nabudi, eme zaeꞌa rune azaḡa moneo ederoga urateꞌohe. Mene fieꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe runeonoꞌo mene bare ḡabodiꞌuma rae zamaradu zamaze areꞌohe. Rehano zaꞌe mene zeḡe teigiꞌuma.
Eme Iesuꞌa rudanadu bare ḡabodiroteꞌe mae ḡihineꞌohe. Eꞌanoꞌo Iesuꞌa bare ovaiteꞌe madaḡano Badiꞌaꞌa iniu Iesu mazao fiadu rudaroteꞌe azaḡa zuni Iesu teite zamaziꞌuma.
Emeḡeꞌa Zuhiꞌa Boro ḡoere ziꞌohe. Eme ḡabode radiꞌuma onamo Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌa ovaiꞌuma, rehano ibite rudaroteꞌe azaḡa mene vitiziꞌuma.

Zuhiꞌa Boro aneꞌa bare adureonoꞌo ovaiteꞌe madaḡano, aniꞌe ḡoere riḡa ḡihau huaꞌuma, ebu tuḡure viga ḡihiꞌaḡaniꞌa huaꞌuma zu Badiꞌa bigoro hudiꞌuma. Eꞌe madaḡano Keriso mazao fiadu rudaroteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa ibite geno ḡabode iḡuniꞌuma.
Eꞌe enogano eme, ꞌize ḡabode radiuꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa zeḡe teite idaḡa mae ḡihifadu ḡoze zamaḡano diuḡiꞌuma ebu adureo Zuhiꞌa Boro hidiꞌuma. Ebu emeꞌe Zuhiꞌa Boro teite radiꞌuma, onamo tuḡutuḡu.
Eꞌanoꞌo zaꞌe ḡoere ꞌahiguḡa hina inaratitoꞌi.
